churches.assessment: Ashland BIC has Pastor Keith A. Tyson, who returned to his home congregation in 2005 after pastoring three other Brethren in Christ congregations in southeastern Pennsylvania. The Brethren in Christ tradition is a distinctive Anabaptist-Pietist-Wesleyan blend with Mennonite roots, holding to believers' baptism, peace witness, and personal holiness. Ashland is the headquarters town for several Brethren denominations, giving this congregation a regional anchor. The yellow rating reflects the BIC denomination's practice of ordaining women, which does not match the male-elders-only standard expected for green — but the local male senior pastor and historic Anabaptist accountability balance the assessment.

churches.assessment: Bay Presbyterian Church in Bay Village, Ohio (Cleveland metro) is a large EPC congregation led by Lead Pastor Mark Tumney. The church offers two Sunday services (9 and 11 AM) plus active programs for children, adults, men, women, students, those with disabilities, a preschool, and missions work. Strong social media presence across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. As an EPC church, the denomination affirms the Westminster Confession and essentials of the Reformed faith. The standard EPC caveat on women-elder policy (varies by presbytery) applies — verify the Midwest Presbytery stance and the local elder board composition. Solid green-eligible option for the Cleveland west suburbs.

churches.assessment: Crossroads Cincinnati is a massive megachurch founded by Brian Tome in 1995. As of April 2026, Tome is on extended leave/suspension after an investigation substantiated allegations of inappropriate physical conduct from 2015 (involving a riding crop incident). The church has female pastors in commissioned and community roles, indicating egalitarian practice. ASL and Spanish translation services available. While culturally engaging, the church's egalitarian leadership structure and current pastoral scandal are significant concerns. The seeker-sensitive, experience-driven approach may prioritize relevance over doctrinal rigor.
churches.gender_detail: Has female commissioned pastors (LaTasha) and female community pastors (Lena — East Side). Egalitarian in practice.
churches.denomination_detail: Non-denominational / Interdenominational megachurch — 9 physical locations in OH and KY

review_flag.reason: Senior pastor Brian Tome under substantiated misconduct finding (Feb 2026); on 1-month suspension followed by 4-month extended leave (through Sep 2026). Investigation confirmed 2015 'inappropriate physical humor' with riding crop; third-party witness corroborated. Additional staff fired Jan 2026 for filming women at gym.

Patriarchal complementarian leadership default. Visit with discernment — GARBC churches often score better than typical IFB on translation and exposition while retaining traditional gender roles.

churches.assessment: Northwest Chapel is a Dublin, Ohio Grace Brethren congregation founded by — and still pastored by — Dr. Terry Hofecker since 1985, four decades and counting. He pulls double duty as Grace Theological Seminary faculty, was a volunteer Police Chaplain at the World Trade Center disaster site in fall 2001, and serves as Project Administrator for biblical archaeology excavations at Tel Gezer in Israel. That's the resume of a serious pastor-scholar. The Charis Fellowship — formerly Fellowship of Grace Brethren Churches, renamed in 2017 — holds dispensational evangelical theology with Anabaptist roots: complementarian, biblically-inerrantist, mission-oriented. Two Sunday services (9:15 and 11 AM), recovery ministry, full lifecycle ministry portfolio. For a Dublin or northwest-Columbus-area man wanting a doctrinally stable, scholar-led Grace Brethren church with multi-decade pastoral continuity, Northwest Chapel is one of the strongest options in central Ohio.

churches.name: Parkside Church
churches.pastor_credentials: Alistair Begg: Trained at London School of Theology; ordained minister since 1975; Truth For Life radio ministry; prolific author and expository preacher

score_notes.christology: Alistair Begg preaches Christ as the only way of salvation with unwavering clarity. Nicene orthodoxy fully affirmed.
score_notes.scripture: Begg is a committed inerrantist. Scripture is the final authority in all matters of faith and practice. Every sermon is text-driven.
score_notes.gender: Male-only elders and pastors. Begg holds a complementarian-to-patriarchal view of male headship in the home and church.
score_notes.leadership: Governed by a plurality of male elders with Begg as senior pastor. Accountability structure in place.
score_notes.soteriology: Justification by faith alone through grace alone. Reformed soteriology clearly preached.
score_notes.cultural: No DEI/CRT accommodation. Begg has resisted cultural drift throughout his entire ministry career. | GREEN signal: *** INITIAL SIGNER (one of the founding 153) *** Pastor Alistair Begg is a public signatory of "The Nashville Statement on Biblical Sexuality" (CBMW, 2017-08-25, cbmw.org/nashville-statement). The Nashville Statement is the post-2017 evangelical line on biblical anthropology, marriage, and sexual ethics — affirming creation order, one-man-one-woman marriage, and biblical sexuality. Signing places the pastor on the orthodox / non-affirming side of the 2017 evangelical fault line.
score_notes.preaching: World-class expository preaching. Begg is widely regarded as one of the finest verse-by-verse preachers alive. Truth For Life broadcasts reach millions.
score_notes.mission: Active missions program. Great Commission centered with global outreach through Truth For Life.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men's ministry and discipleship groups available.
score_notes.denominational: Website returned 403 on validation fetch (possible bot-block rather than true outage). No homepage content retrievable this pass. Alistair Begg's public ministry (Truth For Life) is Reformed/expository/complementarian; prior yellow holds pending direct site evidence — no contradicting evidence.

churches.assessment: Parkside Church under Alistair Begg is one of the premier expository Bible-teaching churches in America. Begg has preached verse-by-verse through Scripture for over 40 years with unwavering commitment to inerrancy, male headship, and the exclusivity of Christ. Truth For Life radio ministry extends his influence globally. The church is elder-led, missions-minded, and doctrinally rock-solid. A top-tier GREEN church. Note: Begg drew controversy in late 2023 for advising a grandmother to attend a grandchild's transgender wedding — he later clarified his pastoral intent but the incident raised some concerns among discernment circles.
churches.gender_detail: Male elders and pastors only; complementarian with strong male headship emphasis
churches.denomination_detail: Independent evangelical — non-denominational

churches.assessment: St. Gertrude Catholic Church in Cincinnati is run by the Dominican Friars of the Province of St. Joseph — an 800-year-old order founded by St. Dominic in 1216, historically associated with Thomistic theology and orthodox Catholic teaching. JD Vance was baptized and confirmed here in August 2019. The Dominican priest who guided his conversion, Fr. Henry Stephan, OP, met with Vance for months over coffee and lunch discussing theology, mysticism, and moral philosophy. Vance's memoir Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith (set for release June 16, 2026) details this journey. From a MOOP Protestant theological-due-diligence frame, this is YELLOW — Catholic sacramental soteriology and the Magisterium-Scripture-Tradition triad fall outside sola fide / sola scriptura, but the Dominican intellectual tradition is rigorously orthodox within Catholic standards and bears noting for situational awareness about where a sitting Vice President converted to the Catholic faith.
churches.denomination_detail: Roman Catholic — Dominican Friars Province of St. Joseph (Order of Preachers, founded 1216); St. Gertrude is one of the order's flagship US parishes.
churches.gender_detail: Male-only Dominican friars and priests per Catholic teaching.
churches.enrichment_notes: Live-fetched https://stgertrude.org/ + The Letters from Leo + Deacon Greg Kandra + American Conservative + RealClearBooks + National Today coverage on 2026-05-16 — confirmed Dominican Friars Province of St. Joseph + Cincinnati OH (Madeira/Miami Ave) + JD Vance baptized + confirmed August 2019 by Fr. Henry Stephan OP. Vance memoir Communion (June 16, 2026 release) corroborates.

churches.assessment: President Warren G. Harding joined the Free Baptist Church in Marion on May 6, 1883, served as a trustee for 25 years and as a deacon, and remained a member until his death in 1923. The Free Baptist Church merged with the First Baptist Church via a joint worship service on September 24, 1911, and was renamed Trinity Baptist Church in April 1912. The congregation that today carries Harding's historical pew has, in the contemporary era, embraced a robust 1689 London Baptist Confession Reformed Baptist confessional identity under Pastor Daniel McCoy (DTS / Master's Seminary), with explicit 9Marks and Founders Ministries affiliation. Worth noting: Harding personally was a theologically liberal Baptist (per Patheos historical assessment), so the present-day Trinity Baptist is more confessionally robust than the congregation Harding inhabited.

churches.enrichment_notes: Live-fetched https://tbcmarion.org/ on 2026-05-16 — confirmed Pastor Daniel McCoy and 1689 LBCF / 9Marks / Founders Ministries confessional posture (NOTE: task prompt assumed SBC; live website states Independent Baptist with explicit confessional affiliations — corrected to Independent Baptist 1689 LBCF). churches.assessment: Sen. John H. Glenn Jr. (D-OH), Marine fighter pilot, first American to orbit Earth (Friendship 7, 1962), four-term U.S. Senator (1974-1999), and at age 77 the oldest astronaut in spaceflight (STS-95, 1998), was raised in this New Concord congregation by his parents John Herschel and Clara Glenn. Glenn's mother was the first female Ruling Elder ordained at Westminster; his father was also a Ruling Elder. Glenn himself was a lifelong Presbyterian Ruling Elder. He and his wife Annie alternated between Westminster (John's family) and College Drive Presbyterian (Annie's family) during their hometown visits. In Washington he attended National Presbyterian Church and served on its Session. The church is currently a PC(USA) mainline congregation under Rev. Ellen Thomas, reflecting denominational shifts that occurred decades after Glenn's formation.
